text:
ali: FYI the new ptq-v2.1 mirror started last night. I'm seeing a small spike in funcall parse errors when requests go through our grpc-proxy.
rene: Any examples? Only via proxy or everywhere?
ali: Log snippet:
```
2026-03-23T02:11:09Z ERROR parser: tool_call parse failed
payload: '{"op":"summarize","params":[{"id":123,"
model: ptq-v2.1
route: canary-proxy-3
```
jess: Looks like truncated JSON (array/object cut). Could be streaming flush or chunk boundary. Did the ptq build change chunk thresholds?
ali: We lowered chunk_size to shave p50. No streaming changes intended.
sam: Product saw ~0.4% more rejects on the canary workspace. Not large but affects a high-value flow.
ali: Repro: mirror 3 for 6k calls, run schema linter. Failures cluster on long lists and triple-backtick code blocks.
jess: Plan: 1) route a small percent to direct-host (bypass proxy); 2) replay with old chunk_size; 3) run fuzz harness with suffix truncation and sentinel.
rene: I'll spin direct-host now and route 3% -> expect traffic in 4m.
canary-bot: started replay-target-direct on host-ptq-v2.1-direct at 2026-03-23T02:28:01Z
ali: Local fuzz shows appending a soft sentinel token ("") recovers outputs. Suggests boundary misalignment rather than model hallucination.
jess: Sentinel is a workaround. Short-term actions: revert chunk_size on canary (low risk), enable parse-rescue on 5% (adds CPU), or serializer sentinel only for toolcall routes (wire-format risk).
sam: Which do we try first?
jess: Revert chunk_size first. It's quick to rollback and likely fixes the clipping. Also add metric toolcall.parse_repaired to compare.
ali: I'll run replay with chunk_size reverted and share diffs. If no fix, we'll enable parse-rescue on 5% mirrored traffic.
rene: Direct-host replica up and receiving mirrored requests.
canary-bot: metric toolcall.parse_repaired created and tagged model=ptq-v2.1,route=canary-proxy-3
sam: Great. Keep me posted with pass/fail counts so we can decide whether to pause full rollout.
ali: Will do. TL;DR: probable proxy boundary + chunking interaction on ptq canary. Revert chunk_size, instrument repair metric, escalate if needed. :white_check_mark:
